# ICSE SEET 2027 — Evaluation Criteria

## Criterion Sets per Category

| Category | Criteria |
|---|---|
| [Research Paper](categories/research-paper) | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Verifiability, Presentation |
| [Experience Report](categories/experience-report) | Relevance, Significance, Actionability, Lessons, Presentation |
| [Idea Paper](categories/idea-paper) | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Presentation |
| [Tool Paper](categories/tool-paper) | Relevance, Significance, Maturity, Availability, Presentation |
| [Replication Paper](categories/replication-paper) | Relevance, Significance, Soundness, Presentation |

## Criterion Definitions

| Criterion | Definition |
|---|---|
| **Relevance** | Extent to which the paper is relevant to SEET. |
| **Significance** | Extent to which the paper is well-motivated and its contributions are original and important w.r.t. existing literature on SE education and training. |
| **Soundness** | Extent to which contributions are supported by rigorous application of appropriate research methods, including meaningful discussion of limitations and threats to validity. |
| **Verifiability** | Sufficient information to support independent verification/replication, including public availability of research data or an explicit statement of why data cannot be shared. |
| **Actionability** | Extent to which the paper provides actionable advice with clear take-away messages. |
| **Lessons** | Meaningful discussion of lessons learned: what went right, what went wrong, what could be improved if repeated. |
| **Maturity** | Extent to which the tool/technology is mature enough to be presented. |
| **Availability** | Whether the tool/technology is available online, open-sourced, or on trial, and how far potential users can evaluate it. |
| **Presentation** | Quality of organization and writing: well-structured, clear correct scholarly language, no ambiguity, readable figures/tables, appropriate formatting. |
